_comment: Base wrangler dev ports per worker. We deliberately skip 8788/8789 because some WSL2 / Windows-host environments reserve them (cloudflared / kernel mirror). Parallel dev (npm run dev:p) sets PORT_OFFSET=5, so the offset must stay >= max(ports) - min(ports) + 1 = 5 today. Bump to 10 when adding a 4th worker.
